text_ar:
و حَدَّثَنِي عَنْ مَالِك عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ
الرَّضَاعَةُ قَلِيلُهَا وَكَثِيرُهَا تُحَرِّمُ وَالرَّضَاعَةُ مِنْ قِبَلِ الرِّجَالِ تُحَرِّمُ
text_ar_search:
و حدثني عن مالك عن ابن شهاب أنه كان يقول
الرضاعة قليلها وكثيرها تحرم والرضاعة من قبل الرجال تحرم
text_en:
Yahya related to me from Malik from Ibn Shihab that he said,
"Suckling however little or much, makes haram. Kinship by suckling
makes men mahram."


Yahya said that he had heard Malik say,
"Suckling, however little or much when it is in the first two years,
makes haram. As for what is after the first two years, little or much,
it does not make anything haram. It is like food."
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepadaku dari Malik dari [Ibnu Syihab] ia berkata; "Penyusuan baik sedikit maupun banyak dapat menjadikan mahram. Penyusuan dari jalan laki-laki juga dapat menjadikan mahram."
